subject: the weekly report rebuild
preview_text: One handoff, one question, no calendar link.
body: Hi Priya, saw Northstar hired a new head of delivery last month. Most agencies in that spot inherit a reporting loop that nobody owns, so every weekly client note gets rebuilt by hand. We mapped that handoff for a 20-person brand team and cut the rebuild from nine hours to five hours a week. Worth a two-minute look at the handoff map? No call needed.
followup_1: Hi Priya, one more data point: the same 20-person team removed two revision rounds per report after the handoff map. Want me to send the one-page version?
followup_2: Hi Priya, I will assume reporting is not a priority this quarter and close the loop. If it becomes one, reply map and I will send the two-minute walkthrough.
